reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architectural pattern descends directly from the mid-2010s shift away from transparent REST APIs toward opaque Single Page Applications (SPAs) and server-side rendering (SSR). Historically, early web scraping relied on predictable URL routing and exposed JSON payloads. As sportsbooks faced increasing pressure from quantitative arbitrageurs, they retroactively closed these leaks, migrating all state logic to secured server environments, effectively creating the 'black box' observed here.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: From the perspective of the platform engineers, this zero-exposure design is a deliberate defensive posture against high-frequency data harvesting and bot-driven market manipulation. They assume external actors possess sophisticated parsing tools and aim to maximize the computational cost of data extraction. Conversely, the quantitative researcher acts as an adversarial agent seeking to minimize this cost, forced to pivot from efficient API interception to inefficient, credential-dependent simulation or visual parsing.
